disabled_rules.content_freshness: The demo is a committed snapshot, so this check measures elapsed calendar time since the snapshot was taken rather than a defect in it. Refreshing the demo more often is the honest cure and is tracked separately.
disabled_rules.title_ambiguity: The demo deliberately keeps near-duplicate titles (substring collisions, republished sources) so findability behaviour is visible; treating those as gate failures would redden the published example on every run. Exact findability for the demo is asserted by the #197 acceptance test instead.
